jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Product Analytics
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Product Analytics to lead analytics for Handshake’s Recruiting marketplace. You’ll drive measurement and strategy across marketplace health, liquidity, pricing, and product-led growth, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to shape the future of our marketplace.

This is a highly impactful, hands-on role where you’ll own analytics strategy, influence product direction, and work alongside our Relevance (ML) team to ensure our models deliver measurable business impact.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and R&D leadership to define and measure marketplace health, liquidity, pricing, and growth.

 - Own analytics strategy, domain metrics, goal setting, and reporting for your product area.

 - Lead experimentation, including test design, instrumentation, analysis, and recommendations.

 - Partner with our Relevance team to evaluate and benchmark machine learning models.

 - Conduct deep analyses across user behavior, funnels, cohorts, and marketplace performance to uncover actionable insights.

 - Collaborate with Analytics Engineering to define trusted metrics and scalable data models.

 - Build dashboards and reporting that enable fast, data-driven decision making.

 - Champion AI-powered workflows and help shape the future of Product Analytics at Handshake.


DESIRED CAPABILITIES

 - 5+ years of experience as a Data Scientist or Product Analyst driving product strategy through data.

 - Expert-level SQL skills with experience analyzing large, complex datasets.

 - Strong experience with experimentation, A/B testing, and statistical analysis.

 - Experience partnering closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

 - Python experience for analytics (e.g., Jupyter notebooks, pandas).

 - Strong business intuition with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.

 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence technical and executive audiences.

 - High ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive ambiguous projects to completion.


EXTRA CREDIT

 - Experience working on marketplace, pricing, or growth analytics.

 - Experience supporting machine learning model evaluation or benchmarking.

 - Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Hex, Mode, or similar platforms.

 - Enthusiasm for AI-first ways of working and leveraging AI tools to accelerate analysis and decision making.


  


PERKS

 - Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported—and thrive at work and in life.
   
   The below benefits are for full-time US employees.
   
   🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company
   
   💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching
   
   🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching
   
   💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, wellness stipend
   
   📚 Growth: Learning stipend, ongoing development
   
   💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office
   
   🏝 Time Off: Flexible PTO, 15 holidays + 2 flex days
   
   🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses
   
   Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers http://joinhandshake.com/careers.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Handshake AI
jobs.description:
ABOUT HANDSHAKE

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We've grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month. Now, we are bringing the same capabilities to grow the Enterprise business.

Why join Handshake now:

 - Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

 - Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world's top educational institutions

 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue


ABOUT HANDSHAKE AI

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.

We're now bringing that same rigor to the enterprise. Handshake AI moves enterprise agents from pilot to production, in a repeatable way, through quality infrastructure such as evals and rubrics, simulations, safety and security testing, and model optimization that encodes an organization's own expertise into durable, sovereign IP the customer owns, at the optimal cost. We work with Fortune 500 leaders to close the gap between AI pilots and production-grade deployment.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be the end-to-end product marketing owner for Handshake AI's frontier lab business, the connective tissue between research, product, sales, and the market. You'll translate deep technical work into positioning that lands with researchers and lab leadership, then arm sales with everything they need to close and grow those relationships. This is a build-from-scratch seat: you'll set the GTM playbook for a business growing faster than almost anything in AI.

 - Positioning & Strategy: Build end-to-end positioning, messaging, and competitive strategy for Handshake AI's frontier lab business, keeping it unified with Handshake's broader career-network story rather than siloed as a separate business.

 - Research Translation: Partner with the HAI research team to turn technical research outputs into market-ready content, building Handshake AI's credibility with researchers and the broader AI community.

 - Content & Website: Build the lab-facing content engine, including one-pagers, conference materials, and a Handshake AI website that is ready to be built out from scratch.

 - Data Catalog: Create and maintain a data gallery, a clear menu of the data types Handshake AI offers, so researchers can see at a glance what is possible.

 - White-Space Discovery: Spot where Handshake's expert human data can add the most value to lab research, and turn those insights into positioning and content.

 - Sales Ownership: Serve as the primary PMM point of contact and decision-maker for how Handshake AI shows up in lab-facing conversations — value props, proof points, pricing/packaging narratives, and objection handling.

 - Sales Enablement Materials: Build and maintain the playbooks, talk tracks, competitive one-pagers, and pitch assets the field runs on, iterating based on direct feedback from Sales.

 - GTM Strategy: Partner with HAI Product and Sales leadership to shape long-term product and GTM strategy — synthesizing customer, competitive, and market insight into clear executive recommendations — and codify the frameworks, launch templates, and messaging systems the broader team reuses.

 - Event & Field Marketing: Partner with the field marketing team to translate HAI positioning into compelling in-person and virtual experiences, owning messaging for executive dinners, field events, and conference activations.

You'll also help stand up Handshake AI's newer Enterprise AI business, co-owning product marketing with a fellow AI product marketer:

 - Content & Thought Leadership: Create content and thought leadership pieces for external awareness, and figure out how to promote them across the website, social, and other channels.

 - Sales Enablement: Build the assets sales needs to sell Enterprise AI into Fortune 500 accounts such as competitive battlecards (backed by ongoing competitive analysis), pitch decks, use case examples, and other collateral.

 - Use Case Prioritization: Prioritize which enterprise use cases and industries to go after, in partnership with a teammate who also works on industry use cases, based on market and customer insight.

 - Event Marketing: Collaborate with the field marketing team (which has dedicated enterprise reps) on which enterprise-specific events to attend and how Handshake AI shows up there.


YOU HAVE

 - 6+ years of experience in product marketing, content marketing, or a related B2B marketing discipline

 - Strong foundation in positioning, messaging, and content creation, including website and social

 - A track record of 0-to-1 program building — comfortable with ambiguity, working independently without a perfect brief, wearing multiple hats, prioritizing, and scaling based on data

 - Ability to influence at all levels, including executives

 - Strong project management skills, with experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder launches

 - Experience building sales enablement materials, including competitive positioning and technical demo content

Bonus points:

 - Experience in the human data or AI training data field

 - AI/ML background or technical fluency, including experience partnering directly with researchers, scientists, or other technical stakeholders

 - Experience marketing to enterprise B2B buyers — ideally in AI/ML infrastructure, data, or a related technical category, with exposure to Fortune 500 sales cycles

 - Experience in demand generation, growth, partner marketing, or full-funnel marketing at a startup


WE OFFER

Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life. The below benefits are for full-time US employees.

🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company

💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching

🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching

💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend

📚 Growth: $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development

💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office

🏝 Time Off: Flexible PTO, 15 holidays + 2 flex days

🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses

Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers http://joinhandshake.com/careers.

jobs.title: VP of Product, Handshake AI
jobs.description:
ABOUT HANDSHAKE

Handshake is the career network for the AI economy. 25 million knowledge workers, 1,600 educational institutions, 1 million employers (including 100% of the Fortune 50), and every foundational AI lab trust Handshake to power career discovery, hiring, and upskilling, from freelance AI training gigs to first internships to full-time careers and beyond. This unique value is leading to unparalleled growth; in 2025, we tripled our ARR at scale.

Why join Handshake now:

 - Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

 - Work hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world's top educational institutions

 - Join a team with leadership from Scale AI, Meta, xAI, Notion, Coinbase, and Palantir, among others

 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue



ABOUT HANDSHAKE AI

Handshake AI is the fastest-growing, most critical, and most revenue-generating part of Handshake's business. We power expert-labeled data collection at scale, matching domain experts with leading AI companies to train frontier models—and we're already a top-three player in one of the fastest-growing sectors in AI: human data. We have the opportunity to do for the AI data economy what LinkedIn did for professional networking: become the default platform where the work happens.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a VP of Product to lead product for Handshake AI. This is not a "head of" role in name only—you will be the product leader for one of the fastest-growing AI startups in the country, owning the strategy, roadmap, and execution that determines how fast and how well we scale.

You'll sit at the center of a business that is compounding quickly: new customers, new data modalities, a growing operator and fellow ecosystem, and an increasingly complex set of platform needs. Your job is to turn that complexity into a coherent product organization—one with clear strategy, strong PM talent, and a roadmap that keeps pace with (and gets ahead of) the business.

You'll report into the CPO, sit on the senior team, and partner directly with Engineering, Design, Operations, and Sales/Customer leadership to shape where Handshake AI goes next.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Product Strategy & Vision. Set the product strategy for Handshake AI as a whole—across data modalities, the operator and fellow platforms, and customer-facing surfaces. Translate "become the career network and data engine for the AI economy" into a concrete, sequenced roadmap.

Team Leadership. Build, lead, and grow a product organization of PMs across modalities and platform pods (e.g., Operator Experience, Fellow Experience, modality-specific pods like Coding). Hire exceptional product talent, set the bar for craft and rigor, and develop the managers and ICs on your team.

Cross-Functional Partnership. Be the connective tissue between Engineering, Design, Operations, and GTM. Ensure the product org's priorities reflect both what customers need and what will scale the business fastest, and that trade-offs across pods are made coherently rather than in silos.

Executive-Level Prioritization. Make and own the hard calls: which modalities to invest in, which platform capabilities to build now vs. later, and where to say no. Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to the exec team and the board.

Metrics & Accountability. Define what success looks like for the product org—revenue enablement, quality outcomes, operator/fellow efficiency, time-to-launch for new modalities and customers—and hold the org accountable to it.

Customer & Market Fluency. Spend real time with AI labs, enterprise customers, and internal stakeholders to understand how the market is evolving. Use that fluency to keep Handshake AI ahead of where the human-data category is heading, not just responsive to it.

Scaling the Platform. Ensure the underlying product and operational platform can flex to new customer types, data types, and volumes—so growth in revenue doesn't require linear growth in headcount or one-off engineering.



DESIRED CAPABILITIES

 - 12+ years in product management, including 4+ years as a senior product leader managing other PMs and managers, ideally at a high-growth startup.

 - Experience owning product for a business (or major business line) growing quickly, with a demonstrated ability to build strategy and org structure that scale with revenue.

 - Strong operational intuition—you've built or overseen platforms for internal users, operations teams, or complex two-sided marketplaces, not just consumer-facing features.

 - Track record hiring and developing product talent, including PMs who own ambiguous, 0→1 problem spaces.

 - Systems thinker who can hold a multi-modality, multi-stakeholder roadmap in their head and make coherent trade-offs across it.

 - Comfortable operating in high ambiguity: the market, the customer needs, and the product surface area are all still being defined.

 - Data-informed but action-oriented—you use metrics to prioritize, but you move with conviction when the signal is directional rather than definitive.

 - Excellent executive communication; you can represent product strategy credibly to the C-suite, the board, and customers.


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience in human data, annotation/labeling, RLHF, or AI training data ecosystems.

 - Experience building or scaling a marketplace or platform business (two-sided, operator/worker-facing, or similar).

 - Prior experience at a fast-growing AI lab, data company, or enterprise SaaS company through a period of hypergrowth.

 - Experience building career, talent, or workforce products.


WE OFFER

Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life. The below benefits are for full-time US employees.

 - 🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company

 - 💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching

 - 🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching

 - 💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend

 - 📚 Growth: $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development

 - 💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office

 - 🏝 Time Off: Flexible PTO, 15 holidays + 2 flex days

 - 🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses

Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers http://joinhandshake.com/careers.
